          const campaignSource = readParam('utm_source');
          const campaignMedium = readParam('utm_medium');
          const campaignContent = readParam('utm_content');

          if (campaignSource) params.campaign_source = campaignSource.slice(0, 100);

 FAQ

## Questions people ask when anxiety feels overwhelming

Practical, direct answers so you know what support you get before downloading.

 What is Anima Felix? -

Anima Felix is an anxiety companion app designed for everyday worry loops, overthinking, panic spikes, and emotional overwhelm. It combines chat, voice onboarding, quick checks, and calming exercises so support is always available in your pocket.

 Is Anima Felix a good app for anxiety and overthinking? -

If your mind keeps looping on “what if” thoughts, Anima Felix is built for that pattern. You can identify your anxiety type, get practical tools in minutes, and follow guided paths that help you calm down and move forward.

 How can I calm anxiety quickly with Anima Felix? -

Start with a quick anxiety check, then use breathing or grounding in the app. A practical sequence that helps many people is: name the loop, regulate the body, then choose one next step.

 Can this app help with panic feelings and physical anxiety symptoms? -

Yes. Anima Felix includes tools for panic spikes, chest-tightness moments, and body-based anxiety signals. Guided breathing and grounding exercises are designed to reduce intensity and help you regain control.

 Which anxiety types are supported in the app? -

Anima Felix supports general anxiety, relationship anxiety, health anxiety, education anxiety, work anxiety, social anxiety, financial anxiety, and parenting anxiety with focused concerns under each path.

 Can I use voice support instead of typing? -

Yes. If talking feels easier than typing, you can begin with voice onboarding at call.animafelix.com and continue your support flow in the app.

 Is Anima Felix therapy or crisis care? -

No. Anima Felix is a wellness companion and not a therapist, diagnosis tool, or emergency service. If you are in immediate danger, call local emergency services or contact 988 in the US.

 Is Anima Felix available on iOS and Android, and how is privacy handled? -

Anima Felix is available on both iOS and Android. Privacy, cookie usage, and account deletion steps are documented clearly on the Privacy, Cookies, and Delete Account pages.

- [Parenting Anxiety Page](https://animafelix.com/anxiety/parenting/): Mental load, decision paralysis, constant child worry

## Available Languages

This site is available in English, Romanian, and Ukrainian.

- [Romanian](https://animafelix.com/ro/): All pages including legal (privacy, terms, cookies, delete); AFK cluster at /ro/afk/* and support at /ro/support/
- [Ukrainian](https://animafelix.com/uk/): All pages including legal (privacy, terms, cookies, delete); AFK cluster at /uk/afk/* and support at /uk/support/
- Note: the AFK mobile app interface itself is currently English-only. The AFK website pages are trilingual.

## Availability

Free on iOS and Android. No subscription required for core features.

## Safety Disclaimer

Anima Felix is a wellness companion. It is not a therapist, diagnosis tool, or emergency service. If you are in immediate danger, call local emergency services or contact 988 (US Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).

    if (!toggle || !menu) return;
    function setOpen(open) {
      menu.classList.toggle('hidden', !open);
      toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open ? 'true' : 'false');
    }
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      setOpen(menu.classList.contains('hidden'));
    });
    document.addEventListener('click', function() {
      setOpen(false);
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape' && !menu.classList.contains('hidden')) {
        setOpen(false);
        toggle.focus();
      }
    });

Exercise guides

## Choose the exercise that matches your anxious moment

Each guide explains the real use case, the visible steps, and how the app version works.

Guided breathing

### Calm Breathing

A simple breathing exercise for anxiety when your mind is racing and your body feels on edge

- Panic spikes and chest-tight moments
- Racing thoughts before sleep
- Stress before meetings, exams, or difficult messages

Grounding technique

### 5-4-3-2-1 Grounding

A sensory grounding exercise for anxiety when your mind leaves the room and your body needs something concrete

- Sudden anxiety surges and panic feelings
- Overthinking after a trigger or difficult message
- Feeling detached, unreal, or mentally scattered

Body relaxation

### Deep Body Relaxation

A body-scan style exercise for anxiety that feels trapped in your muscles, chest, jaw, and stomach

- Muscle tension and clenched shoulders or jaw
- Physical stress after a long workday
- Health-anxiety moments where the body feels suspicious

Interactive exercise

### Stress Jenga

An overwhelm exercise that helps you find the one stressor that lightens the whole stack

- Mental overload and shutdown
- Work or study pressure that feels impossible to sort
- Parenting or financial stress with too many moving parts
